questions.question_text: The type of isomerism shown by the complex [CoCl2(en)2] is ——
questions.answer: [CoCl2(en)2] can form cis and trans isomers based on the position of chloride ions, hence shows geometrical isomerism.
questions.chapter: Unit 1: Isomerism in transitional metal compounds

questions.question_text: In K4[Fe(CN)6] the number of unpaired electrons in iron are?
questions.answer: Fe in [Fe(CN)6]^4- is in the +2 oxidation state, and CN- is a strong field ligand, causing electron pairing and leaving no unpaired electrons.
questions.chapter: Unit 1: OpƟcal & magneƟc properƟes of transiƟon metal complexes

questions.question_text: The spin only magnetic moment value (in Bohr magneton units) of Cr(CO)6 is—.
questions.answer: Cr in Cr(CO)6 is in the zero oxidation state and CO is a strong field ligand; all electrons are paired, magnetic moment is zero.
questions.chapter: Unit 1: OpƟcal & magneƟc properƟes of transiƟon metal complexes

questions.question_text: Which is correct according to ligands in spectrochemical series?
questions.answer: In the spectrochemical series, the ligand field strength increases as shown: I- < Cl- < H2O < en (ethylenediamine).

questions.question_text: _________ is the device used to measure the emf of the cell.
questions.answer: A potentiometer precisely measures the emf of a cell by balancing voltage without drawing any current.

questions.question_text: The rusting of Iron is——.
questions.answer: Rusting of iron mainly occurs in the presence of moisture and oxygen, which is known as wet corrosion.

questions.question_text: Helmholtz free energy A is expressed as——.
questions.answer: Helmholtz free energy (A) is defined as internal energy (U) minus the product of temperature and entropy (TS).

questions.question_text: Passivation is due to formation of——.
questions.answer: Passivation protects metals from corrosion by forming a thin, non-reactive metal oxide layer on the surface.

questions.question_text: Which of the following is least stable?
questions.answer: In eclipsed conformation, atoms are aligned, leading to maximum torsional strain, making it least stable.

questions.question_text: Which step in SN1 reaction is a slow rate determining step?
questions.answer: The formation of the carbocation intermediate (transition state) is the slow, rate-determining step in SN1 reactions.
questions.chapter: Unit 3: Introduction to reactions involving substitution

questions.question_text: Which of the following is an initiator molecule in the free radical polymerisation?
questions.answer: Benzoyl peroxide decomposes to generate free radicals, initiating the polymerisation process.

questions.question_text: Which of the following would exhibit co-ordination isomerism?
questions.answer: Coordination isomerism occurs when ligands exchange between two metals in a complex, as in [Cr(NH3)6][Co(CN)6].
questions.chapter: Unit 1: Isomerism in transiƟonal metal compounds

questions.question_text: Which among the following polymers have lowest solubility?
questions.answer: Epoxy resin is a thermosetting polymer with a highly cross-linked structure, making it less soluble.

questions.question_text: What is the range of tensile strength, exhibited by fibres? .
questions.answer: Fibres typically show tensile strength in the range of 20,000-150,000 psi (or equivalent units), much higher than many other materials.
questions.chapter: Unit 5: Mechanical properties of solid - Tensile strength

questions.question_text: Which of the following is a co-polymer?
questions.answer: Bakelite is formed from two different monomers (phenol and formaldehyde), making it a co-polymer.

questions.question_text: Which of the following is NOT a natural polymer?
questions.answer: Rayon is a semi-synthetic fiber made from cellulose but processed chemically, thus not truly natural.

questions.question_text: After the proportionality limit in the stress strain curve, we observe
questions.answer: The elastic limit comes just after the proportionality limit, beyond which deformation is not fully reversible.

questions.question_text: In fiber reinforced composites which constituent will fail last
questions.answer: In most fiber-reinforced composites, the matrix fails after the fiber (filler), offering support till the last.

questions.question_text: Kevlar is a type of material.
questions.answer: Kevlar is a high-strength synthetic polymer belonging to the aramid family.

questions.question_text: The source for XPS is --
questions.answer: AlKa (Aluminum K-alpha) X-rays are commonly used as the excitation source in X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS).
